method: Bounded interpretation of all candidate-group builder instructions. Complete 1792-byte body regions, 12-byte reusable groups including padding, eight-slot body arrays, bucket records and group count are compared. Fixtures cover tagged buckets, all eligibility gates, duplicate physical-list pointers, negative/zero/positive previous counts, stale list entries and counts outside the cleared range, plus trailing sentinel. Only __security_check_cookie is an explicit external boundary and its cookie argument is checked; no original process execution or allocator inference.
